articles.title: BA Graduate Performs C-Section for ₹3,000: Mother and Child Die in Ambedkar Nagar Illegal Hospital.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shocking case from Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 🚨 A pregnant woman and her newborn allegedly died due to gross medical negligence at an illegal private facility operating as Navjeevan Hospital in Baskhari Bazaar.

body.html:
Shocking case from Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 🚨

A pregnant woman and her newborn allegedly died due to gross medical negligence at an illegal private facility operating as Navjeevan Hospital in Baskhari Bazaar.

Priyanka, wife of Sandeep Kumar Verma from Bukiya village, was admitted on February 5 after labour pain. A C-section was performed at the facility, following which she reportedly began bleeding heavily. As her condition worsened, she was referred to a private hospital in Akbarpur and later advised to be shifted to Lucknow. She died on the way during the night of February 6–7.

A health department probe revealed the hospital had allegedly been operating illegally for nearly five years and that the surgery was performed by unqualified individuals.

The accused include Yogesh Yadav, a BA graduate, and Shubham Vishwakarma, an Intermediate pass. Police said Yogesh allegedly learned basic medical procedures informally from his father, a former ward boy at CHC Jalalpur, and went on to perform the C-section. The hospital operator, Ruby, is absconding.

Both accused were arrested from Baskhari and sent to jail. Circle Officer Nitish Tiwari confirmed that further investigation is underway.

The incident has sparked serious concerns over illegal medical facilities and regulatory lapses in rural UP.

articles.title: MBA Student Found Strangled in Indore; Objectionable Videos Posted Before Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, the naked and decomposed body of a 24-year-old MBA student was found in her classmate’s rented house in the Dwarkapuri area on Friday, February 13, 2026. Rope marks around her neck indicate she was strangled.

body.html:
In a shocking case from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, the naked and decomposed body of a 24-year-old MBA student was found in her classmate’s rented house in the Dwarkapuri area on Friday, February 13, 2026. Rope marks around her neck indicate she was strangled.

The victim was a first-year MBA student at an institute on Sanwer Road. Her body had decomposed to such an extent that her father reportedly identified her only by her socks. Residents of Uncle Gali alerted police after a foul smell began emanating from the locked room. Police broke open the door and recovered the body.

According to police, the student was last seen on February 10. Earlier that day, she had gone with her father to the Collectorate to get her birth certificate corrected. Later in the evening, she informed her family that she was attending a birthday party with her classmate and alleged boyfriend, Piyush Dhanotia, and would return by 11 pm. She did not return home.

That same night, around 11 objectionable videos were allegedly posted from her phone to her college WhatsApp group and uploaded on her WhatsApp status. In the clips, her face was visible while the man’s face was covered with emojis. College authorities removed the video and informed her father on Wednesday, also stating that both her phone and Dhanotia’s phone were switched off.

A missing person’s complaint was registered late Wednesday night at the Pandharinath Police Station. The family alleged there was little urgency in tracing her despite repeated pleas.

Police suspect she was strangled on the night of February 10 following an altercation. Preliminary medical examination suggests death occurred around three days before the body was found. The final post-mortem report is awaited.

Dhanotia, originally from Mandsaur, allegedly fled Indore by train on February 10. He was arrested from the Andheri area of Mumbai on Sunday, February 15. On February 16, a court sent him to three-day police remand for further interrogation and reconstruction of the crime scene.

The victim’s father alleged that his daughter was mentally tortured and blackmailed by Dhanotia, who allegedly demanded money for college fees and threatened to leak private videos. Police said the murder may have stemmed from a rift in their romantic relationship.

Deputy Commissioner of Police Krishna Lalchandani stated that prima facie evidence points to strangulation with a rope, and further details will be confirmed after the post-mortem report.

articles.title: Hyderabad Horror: Man Dragged for 700 Meters by Speeding Bolero in Kushaiguda; 2 Arrested.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad (Telangana): A shocking road rage incident in Kushaiguda left a man critically injured after he was hit and dragged for several meters by a speeding Bolero on February 9 evening. Sequence of Events: The incident began in the Nacharam police station area when P.

body.html:
Hyderabad (Telangana): A shocking road rage incident in Kushaiguda left a man critically injured after he was hit and dragged for several meters by a speeding Bolero on February 9 evening.

Sequence of Events:
The incident began in the Nacharam police station area when P. Raju, a private company employee, was returning home in his MG Windsor car after work in Mallapur.

Near Mallapur X-Road, a Bolero (registration number TS09FF0094) allegedly rammed into Raju’s vehicle from behind and fled the scene without stopping.

Raju’s friends reportedly chased the Bolero and intercepted it near H.B. Colony under the jurisdiction of Kushaiguda Police Station.

Assault and Dragging Incident:
When one of Raju’s friends, identified as Satish, stood in front of the Bolero to question the occupants, the accused allegedly rammed the vehicle into him. As the SUV moved forward, Satish was dragged for several meters while clinging to the bumper.

He sustained serious injuries and was rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment.

Police Action:
Kushaiguda police registered a case and launched an investigation. The Bolero was seized, and the two accused — Uppari Mahesh and Angandula Tarun, residents of Balaji Nagar — were arrested.

Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody.

Police are continuing further investigation into the incident, which has triggered public outrage over reckless driving and violent road rage in the city.

articles.title: Bengaluru: US-Returned Engineer Arrested for Murdering Retired Navy Captain Father and Dentist Mothe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident in Bengaluru, a 33/34-year-old US-returned software engineer, Rohan Chandra Bhat, was arrested on February 11, 2026, for allegedly murdering his parents at their upscale villa in Vignan Nagar.

body.html:
In a shocking incident in Bengaluru, a 33/34-year-old US-returned software engineer, Rohan Chandra Bhat, was arrested on February 11, 2026, for allegedly murdering his parents at their upscale villa in Vignan Nagar.

The victims were identified as Naveen Chandra Bhat (60), a retired Indian Navy Captain, and Dr Shyamala Bhat (55), a practising dentist. The attack took place at their residence in Adarsh Vista, a gated community under the HAL Police Station limits.

According to Bengaluru City Police, the dispute began on Tuesday night and escalated on Wednesday morning between 7:30 am and 8:00 am. Neighbours, alerted by screams, rushed the couple to Manipal Hospital, where they were declared brought dead.

Preliminary investigation suggests the crime was triggered by a financial dispute. Rohan, who had returned from the United States three years ago and was reportedly unemployed, allegedly demanded ₹4 lakh from his parents to fund a startup venture. When they refused and questioned his lack of steady employment, a heated argument ensued, leading to the alleged knife attack.

After his arrest, Rohan reportedly displayed unstable behaviour and gave contradictory statements. A preliminary medical evaluation indicated possible schizophrenia (psychosis).

Instead of being lodged in regular custody, he has been referred to National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) for psychiatric assessment and medical fitness certification.

The couple’s daughter, who is based in the United States, is travelling to Bengaluru to complete post-mortem formalities and perform the final rites.

articles.title: Man Beaten to Death in Prayagraj After Objecting to Public Urination; UP Constable Among Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh): A 45-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death with an iron rod in Madauka village under the Naini area on February 12, 2026, following a dispute with wedding guests.

body.html:
Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh): A 45-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death with an iron rod in Madauka village under the Naini area on February 12, 2026, following a dispute with wedding guests.

The Incident:
The deceased, Rajesh Nishad, reportedly objected to members of a wedding procession urinating near his house. The altercation escalated into violence, during which he was allegedly attacked with an iron rod.

He was rushed to a hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

Key Accused:
The main accused in the case is Sunil Kanojia, a constable of the Uttar Pradesh Police, currently posted in Mau district. Kanojia was reportedly attending his cousin’s wedding at a nearby guest house when the confrontation occurred.

According to reports, the dispute began either after Nishad objected to guests urinating near his home or when he refused to allow them to relieve themselves on an adjacent empty plot.

Police Action:
Police have registered a case against 12 named individuals in connection with the assault.

As of February 14, six people, including Sunil Kanojia, have been arrested. Authorities have stated that further investigation is underway to determine the exact sequence of events and the roles of all accused.

The incident has drawn attention due to the involvement of a serving police constable in the alleged crime.

articles.title: Clashes Erupt in Mirpur Hindu Village Over Proposed Dumping Ground
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): Tension prevailed in Mirpur Hindu village following clashes between protesting farmers and police over the construction of a proposed dumping ground near Techno City under the limits of Loni Police Station.

body.html:
Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh): Tension prevailed in Mirpur Hindu village following clashes between protesting farmers and police over the construction of a proposed dumping ground near Techno City under the limits of Loni Police Station.

Protest Over Environmental Concerns:
Farmers and villagers have been opposing the dumping ground project for several weeks, alleging that it would lead to severe environmental pollution and increase the risk of disease in the area.

On Sunday, when administrative and municipal teams arrived to begin work at the site, a large number of male and female farmers gathered and began raising slogans against the project.

Police Action and Injuries:
According to eyewitnesses, police initially attempted to persuade the protesters to disperse. However, as the situation escalated and the crowd refused to back down, police allegedly resorted to a lathi charge to disperse the gathering.

Reports claim that more than 60 farmers sustained injuries during the police action. A female farmer was seriously injured after being struck on the head and other parts of her body and was admitted to a nearby hospital for treatment.

While local accounts describe the action as a lathi charge, senior police officials have not formally confirmed this, stating that “mild force” was used to control the crowd.

Security Measures and Current Situation:
Following the incident, farmer leaders condemned the administration and intensified protests. A heavy police presence has been deployed in the village to prevent further escalation.

Provincial Armed Constabulary (PAC) units have also been put on alert amid ongoing tensions.

Authorities have stated that the situation is currently under control, though resentment among villagers remains high. The administration has yet to issue a detailed statement regarding the future of the proposed dumping ground project.

articles.title: SP Leader Lal Bahadur Yadav Killed After High-Mast Pole Falls on Car in Pratapgarh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pratapgarh (Uttar Pradesh): Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Lal Bahadur Yadav (47) died in a tragic accident on Sunday, February 15, 2026, after a high-mast light pole collapsed onto his moving car in the Babu Ganj market area.

body.html:
Pratapgarh (Uttar Pradesh): Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Lal Bahadur Yadav (47) died in a tragic accident on Sunday, February 15, 2026, after a high-mast light pole collapsed onto his moving car in the Babu Ganj market area.

The Accident:
The incident occurred around 1:00 PM under the jurisdiction of Antu Police Station.

According to police, workers were installing a high-mast light pole—reportedly weighing around 1,000 kg—near a Bharat Petroleum outlet when it allegedly lost balance and toppled onto the road. The falling structure landed directly on Yadav’s Hyundai Creta.

CCTV footage from the area captured the moment of impact, showing the front portion of the vehicle being completely crushed while the rear reportedly lifted nearly two feet into the air due to the force.

Rescue and Death:
Yadav, who was alone in the vehicle, became trapped inside and sustained critical injuries. Local residents rushed to the scene and helped move the heavy pole to rescue him.

He was immediately taken to a nearby hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

Background:
Lal Bahadur Yadav was a resident of Babu Ganj market and an active member of the Samajwadi Party. He had contested the 2022 Antu Nagar Panchayat elections.

Apart from his political involvement, he was also a Public Works Department (PWD) contractor and held a local country liquor license.

Investigation Underway:
Preliminary findings indicate possible negligence during the installation process of the high-mast light. Police have sent the body for post-mortem examination and stated that strict action will be taken against those found responsible.

Authorities are examining CCTV footage and questioning workers involved in the installation as part of the ongoing investigation.

articles.title: Janjgir-Champa: Speeding Tanker Rams into Wedding Procession; Several Injured Near Ghivra.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh): A wedding procession (baraat) in Janjgir-Champa district turned into a scene of chaos on the night of February 11, 2026, when a speeding heavy vehicle ploughed into guests dancing along the roadside, leaving multiple people injured.

body.html:
Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh): A wedding procession (baraat) in Janjgir-Champa district turned into a scene of chaos on the night of February 11, 2026, when a speeding heavy vehicle ploughed into guests dancing along the roadside, leaving multiple people injured.

Incident Details:
The accident occurred around 10:00 PM near Ghivra village under the jurisdiction of Birra Police Station.

According to eyewitnesses, the baraat was moving along the roadside, and guests were dancing in a cluster near the road to DJ music when a heavy “capsule” vehicle (reportedly a tanker) approached from the Shivrinarayan side. The vehicle allegedly veered off the road, crushed a roadside tent, and rammed into the group of celebrants.

Videos circulating on social media capture the sudden impact, showing the transition from festivities to panic, with guests scrambling to escape and others rushing to help the injured.

Casualties and Injuries:
Police reports indicate that at least four to five people sustained injuries. Among them:
● Usha Bai Dewangan (53) – Critical condition after a wheel reportedly ran over her thigh; referred to a hospital in Bilaspur.
● Tara Chand Dewangan – District Congress president of neighbouring Sarangarh-Bilaigarh; injured in the impact.
● Bhuri Bai (65)
● Radhika Dewangan
● Redhuka Dewangan (55)

While one victim remains in serious condition and was shifted to Bilaspur for advanced treatment, the others are undergoing treatment locally.

Driver Detained:
Angry guests reportedly apprehended and assaulted the driver before police arrived. Officers later detained the driver, seized the vehicle, and registered a case.

According to police, the driver claimed he dozed off at the wheel, resulting in loss of control. Authorities have stated that this claim is being verified as part of the ongoing investigation.

Investigation Underway:
Police are examining the circumstances surrounding the crash, including the driver’s statement and vehicle condition. Further legal proceedings are in progress.

The incident has sparked concern over road safety during public celebrations, especially when gatherings spill onto active roadways.
